fusions.name: Flush and Strike
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to a target and strikes it for 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Alarm Call
fusions.desc: Blasts a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to every enemy in it with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Already Gone
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Your movement speed rises 30% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Running Start
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your crit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
